**Preferred gene-related syndrome label**
EFL1-related Shwachman-Diamond syndrome

**Synonyms**
MONDO:0044205

**Parent term (use [OLS](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/mondo), or your favorite ontology browser)**

**Definition**
An autosomal recessive syndrome characterized by exocrine pancreatic dysfunction, hematopoietic abnormalities, short stature, and metaphyseal dysplasia and caused by pathogenic variants in the EFL1 gene.
